# Search titles, body, and metadata with filters and limits; inspect board views.
exec tuck$exe init
exec tuck$exe add 'Alpha guide' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Beta guide' --state done
exec tuck$exe add 'Gamma guide' --state doing
exec tuck$exe meta set 002 labels '["blue", "green"]'
exec tuck$exe meta set 002 category '"images"'

exec tuck$exe list --json
json
stdout '"state": "doing"'
stdout '"title": "Alpha guide"'
stdout '"state": "done"'

exec tuck$exe list
stdout '^DOING$'
stdout '^TODO$'
stdout '^BACKLOG$'
stdout '^RECENT$'
stdout 'Gamma guide'
stdout 'Alpha guide'
stdout 'Fixture task'
stdout 'Beta guide'

exec tuck$exe list todo
stdout '^TODO$'
stdout '002 Alpha guide'
! stdout 'Beta guide'

exec tuck$exe list --limit=1
stdout '004 doing   Gamma guide'
! stdout 'Alpha guide'

exec tuck$exe find GUIDE --json
json
stdout '(?s)"title": "Gamma guide".*"title": "Alpha guide".*"title": "Beta guide"'
exec tuck$exe find guide --limit=1 --json
json
stdout '"title": "Gamma guide"'
! stdout '"title": "Alpha guide"'
exec tuck$exe find alpha guide --state=todo --limit 1
stdout '002 todo    Alpha guide'
exec tuck$exe find fixture --state=backlog --json
json
stdout '"number": "001"'
exec tuck$exe find guide --recent --state=done --json
json
stdout '"title": "Beta guide"'
! stdout '"title": "Alpha guide"'
! stdout '"title": "Gamma guide"'

exec tuck$exe find catalog --json
json
stdout '"title": "Fixture task"'
exec tuck$exe find IMAGES --meta=category='"images"' --json
json
stdout '"number": "002"'
exec tuck$exe find guide --meta 'labels=["blue","green"]' --json
json
stdout '"number": "002"'
! stdout '"number": "003"'

exec tuck$exe find nonexistent --json
json
stdout '"tasks": '
! stdout '"title":'
